study: Exploratory probability calibration after inspection of historical tests
fit_split: resolution_manifest calibration indices, clean images only
scope: Internal test only; fixed models and fitted temperatures; paired image bootstrap over mean seed metrics. No external raw images fetched or external thresholds changed.
rank_check: Positive temperature preserves theoretical confidence ordering and class predictions. Thresholds are transformed with the same temperature, not kept numerically fixed. Use original scores for rank metrics to avoid saturation artifacts.
claims: Exploratory follow-up; already inspected internal/external tests do not become held-out confirmatory tests. Calibration fit loss is not an unbiased performance estimate.
